title: Cuñapé
description: Cuñapé is a dish from Bolivia featuring whole cow milk, tapioca starch, queso fresco, chicken egg. This home-sized recipe records each ingredient at the step where it is used.

steps.instruction: Cook the listed ingredients in simmering water for about 10 minutes until tender; drain well if necessary.
Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Divide and shape the prepared mixture or dough into even portions and arrange on a lined baking sheet or appropriate molds, leaving enough room for expansion.
Bake the already topped dough in a fully preheated 230–250°C oven until the base is crisp and toppings are cooked.
